critical_code_review_comments: Second round in a row where a claimed fix was reported but never written to disk (iter 253: EventPackingSection literals; iter 254: Dashboard deps array). Grep the literal/deps after editing and reload the actual page before declaring FIXED.

Prefer computing terminology-dependent strings during render instead of inside async useCallback bodies; the dependency-array approach is fragile and re-triggers full data fetches whenever terminology resolves.
